meaning: The pose a session starts from: arm folded at rest, gripper open at an opening whose wrist jaw reference is stored. `sweepick_pick01.py prepare <out> <side>` moves an arm there (and releases it) when the read pose is off; observe never needs a person to set it.

gripper_rule: accepted as it is when within 5 ticks of an opening with a stored jaw reference or within 20 ticks of gripper_open_tick; otherwise opened to gripper_open_tick (always inside the servo range)
release_sag_basis: 2026-10-18 174444: the left wrist_flex reached the start pose 14 ticks off with torque on and settled 16 ticks off once released (its own weight). The move aims at 14; after the release the start pose is accepted within 14 + 20
